question: Should ClawHub/OpenClaw still support the legacy `https://molt.bot/install.sh` zsh installer, or should that path be redirected or retired in favor of current install commands?
rationale: The failing installer implementation is absent from current main, while current docs and UI point to maintained OpenClaw/ClawHub install commands; automation cannot choose whether an externally hosted legacy setup path remains product-supported.

options.title: Redirect or retire the legacy installer
options.body: Point `molt.bot` users to the maintained `openclaw` and `clawhub` install commands and document the supported Node floor.

options.title: Support and harden the legacy installer
options.body: Bring the installer source under traceable ownership, reproduce the macOS/Homebrew zsh failure, and guard unmatched cleanup globs.

options.title: Wait for a fresh reporter reproduction
options.body: Keep this issue waiting on author until there is evidence that the current hosted installer still fails.

recommendation.title: Redirect or retire the legacy installer
recommendation.body: Point `molt.bot` users to the maintained `openclaw` and `clawhub` install commands and document the supported Node floor.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the clearest current owner for the maintained ClawHub CLI/package install surface and release state.
